So I transmigrated to this world and into this powerful body, sounds like a great start... except it's all bullshit! My familiar is no Lunar Butterfly!! It's just a low-level glow moth that can barely light up a room!!! Now I'm faced with millions of fanatical believers, a battle with the Emperor Cangyue scheduled in three years time, and all of the major sects who see me as a thorn in their eyes... This is… big trouble for a beast-master! (Source: Bilibili, translated)
